data.task_title: Load and analyze pipeline execution data

features.title: Optimization Insights
features.description: Generate insights to identify opportunities for pipeline optimization.
acceptance_criteria: System highlights potential areas for performance improvement.
Users receive recommendations based on data analysis.
Insights are presented in a clear and actionable format.

features.title: Data Visualization
features.description: Create visualizations to represent pipeline execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view graphical representations of pipeline metrics.
Visualizations include charts and graphs for key performance indicators.
Users can interact with visualizations to filter and zoom in on data.

features.title: Interactive Jupyter Notebook
features.description: Develop an interactive Jupyter notebook interface for data analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Users can interact with the notebook to perform data analysis tasks.
Notebook supports running custom Python scripts for advanced analysis.
Users can save and load notebook sessions.

features.title: Data Loading
features.description: Implement functionality to load pipeline execution data into the Jupyter notebook.
acceptance_criteria: Users can upload pipeline execution data files.
Data is validated for correct format and completeness.
Error messages are provided for invalid data uploads.

features.title: Statistical Summaries
features.description: Provide statistical summaries of pipeline performance data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can access summary statistics such as mean, median, and standard deviation.
Summaries are updated dynamically based on the data loaded.
Users can export statistical summaries to a CSV file.
